description: This file contains the implementation of logging and log retrieval functions for the Mattermost platform, including logger configuration, log file access, and log filtering.

classes.name: PlatformService
classes.description: Service class providing logging and log management functionalities.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Returns the logger interface for the platform service.

methods.name: ReconfigureLogger
methods.description: Reinitializes and reconfigures the logging system.

methods.name: initLogging
methods.description: Initializes and configures the logging system, creating and setting up log targets.

methods.name: RemoveUnlicensedLogTargets
methods.description: Removes log targets if the license does not support advanced logging features.

methods.name: GetLogsSkipSend
methods.description: Retrieves log lines from the log file with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: GetLogFile
methods.description: Returns the entire log file content as a file data object.

methods.name: validateLogFilePath
methods.description: Validates that a log file path is within the allowed logging directory.

methods.name: GetAdvancedLogs
methods.description: Retrieves additional log files based on advanced logging configuration.

methods.name: isLogFilteredByLevel
methods.description: Checks if a log entry is filtered out based on log level.

methods.name: isLogFilteredByDate
methods.description: Checks if a log entry is filtered out based on date range.
